Config.Title: New Group Roll — CoC7
Config.Label: Roll name
Config.LabelPlaceholder: e.g. Chase through the catacombs, Clue search...
Config.CanvasClickHint: Click a portrait, or click a player token directly on the scene to add it
Config.PickActorsFirst: Select participants first to see their skills
Config.NoSkillSelected: Pick a roll on the left
Config.GlobalDiceHint: Applied to newly added participants; can be overridden individually in the Selected list
Config.NoParticipantsWarning: Add at least one participant before rolling
Config.NoSkillWarning: Pick a skill or characteristic before rolling
Config.LaunchHint: Rolls immediately for all selected participants (GM rolls the dice)
Config.SendRequestHint: Sends a roll request to the owning players of selected participants ("Included" badge), who will roll their own dice
Config.NoEligiblePlayers: No selected participant has an active player owner (or all are excluded)
Config.WillRequestTitle: This participant will receive a request if you click "Send Request"
Config.WillGMTitle: This participant will be ignored by "Send Request"; click to include it
Config.Teams: Opposed roll by teams (A vs B)
Config.TeamsHint: Compares the best success level of each team
Config.DifficultyHint: If set, each result is compared against this minimum required level to succeed
Config.PickTokens: Quick token selection from the scene
Config.DropZone: Drag actors here, or use the buttons below
Config.NoParticipants: No participants yet. Drag actors here or add selected tokens.
Config.Glisser: or drop an actor on the window

Request.Title: Roll Request
Request.Intro: The Keeper is requesting a roll:

Settings.PlaySoundHint: Plays a sound on launch and on result reveal
Settings.SoundRollHint: Path to the audio file played during the animation
Settings.SoundCompleteHint: Played when the winner(s) are revealed, unless a fumble occurred
Settings.SoundFumbleHint: Played instead of the victory sound if a fumble occurs during the roll
Settings.RollDurationHint: How long numbers spin before revealing the result
Settings.AffichageHint: Banner: a band with portraits for everyone, each player rolls from their portrait. Window: the former layout.
Settings.EffetsCritiquesHint: Shows Critiques du Mythe full-screen cards (if active) on criticals and fumbles.
Settings.ThemeHint: Automatic: follows the era set with Bascule d'époque, otherwise the chat card theme.
Settings.RattrapageHint: After rolling, failed investigators may push or spend Luck from the banner.
Settings.ExperienceHint: A first-roll success checks the skill's experience box. No experience for pushed rolls, spent Luck or hidden rolls.

Banniere.Secret: Only the Keeper sees the results

Rattrapage.Titre: Push the roll or spend Luck?
Rattrapage.PousserAide: Reroll once (a failed pushed roll has consequences)

Adversaire.Aide: The Keeper rolls for the opponent; each investigator is compared to them.

San.Aide: E.g. 0/1D4, 1/1D6. A fumble loses the maximum. Loss is applied to sheets.

Favori.Aide: Save this roll as a macro (Shift+click to edit)
Favori.MJ: Only the Keeper can start a group roll.
